action: Update Splunk SOAR to 8.8.0 or later and Splunk Enterprise to a fixed version (10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12 or 9.4.17), as listed by UzCERT; check Splunk's own advisory.
date_note: UzCERT says Splunk announced the issues on 18 November 2026; the Splunk advisory itself was not read.
exec: Splunk SOAR and Splunk Enterprise have new critical and high-severity flaws, so security teams running them should patch.
plain: Uzbekistan's CERT reports that Splunk fixed serious flaws in SOAR and Splunk Enterprise, including remote code execution and authentication bypass. UzCERT does not say they are being exploited.
summary: UzCERT says Splunk announced on 18 November fixes for flaws in Splunk SOAR and Splunk Enterprise. Two SOAR remote code execution flaws are rated 9.9 and 9.6 and a SOAR SSO authentication bypass is rated high; all are fixed in SOAR 8.8.0 or later. A Splunk Enterprise RapidDiag REST API bypass is fixed in several versions. UzCERT does not state exploitation.
title: Splunk fixes critical SOAR and Enterprise flaws, UzCERT reports

validation.note: Verify desk read the UzCERT page (18 Nov 2026): CVSS 9.9 and 9.6 SOAR remote code execution, SSO bypass rated high, fixed in SOAR 8.8.0 or later, RapidDiag bypass in Enterprise; no exploitation stated. Matches the record. Splunk's own advisory is not cited by UzCERT and was not read.
